home.introTitle: An-Nur Mosque – Afghan Islamic Cultural Association Wiesbaden and Surroundings e.V.
introParagraphs: An-Nur means light and hope: a place where people gather to live out their faith, share knowledge and work together toward a better future. Beyond daily prayer and spiritual life, our mosque and association make room for education, social support and cultural exchange.
Whatever brings you here – a question about Islam, a wish to learn more, or simply the search for community – you are welcome.

From Quran lessons for children and adults to inspiring events and social outreach, An-Nur is a place where faith and humanity stand at the centre. Come and become part of a network that holds together, supports and inspires.

aboutMosque.title: Our mosque – a place of faith and encounter in Wiesbaden
aboutMosque.subtitle: Freshly renovated and ready for the future – our mosque offers space for community, spirituality and new perspectives.
aboutMosque.homeIntro: Our mosque in Wiesbaden is a place of faith and togetherness. Following a thorough refurbishment, it offers a warm and welcoming atmosphere for prayer, Quran lessons and events. It may not be ostentatious, but its simplicity is exactly what makes it an authentic meeting place for everyone who values community and faith.

quranSchool.title: Quran school
quranSchool.subtitle: Imparting Islamic knowledge for children and adults alike.
body: Our Quran school gives children, young people and adults the chance to learn to read the Quran, understand its meaning and grow in their everyday practice of faith.
Classes are taught in small, age-appropriate groups by experienced teachers, with room for questions and open discussion alongside recitation and memorisation.
New pupils are welcome to join at any time – get in touch to find a group that fits.

socialProjects.title: Social projects
socialProjects.subtitle: Supporting people and projects with heart and commitment.
body: Solidarity is at the heart of our community. Through our social projects we support families, newcomers and people in need, both here in Wiesbaden and, where we can, back in Afghanistan.
Our volunteers organise food and clothing drives, offer practical everyday support and coordinate emergency aid whenever it is needed most.
If you would like to get involved as a volunteer or know someone who needs support, please reach out to us.

ourOrganisation.title: Our organisation
ourOrganisation.subtitle: The history and people behind the association.
body: The Afghan Islamic Cultural Association Wiesbaden and Surroundings e.V. was founded by members of the local Afghan community to give the growing congregation a permanent home for prayer, education and cultural life.
Today the association is carried by an active board and a wide circle of volunteers who plan events, coordinate community projects and keep the mosque running for everyone who relies on it.
We welcome new members who want to help shape the future of our community.

footballTeam.title: An-Nur football team
footballTeam.subtitle: Community, passion and team spirit – football at An-Nur.
body: Sport brings our community together across generations. The An-Nur football team gives young people and adults a place to train, compete and build friendships outside the mosque.
The team trains regularly and takes part in local matches and tournaments throughout the year.
New players are always welcome – contact us to join a training session.

consulting.title: Consulting & services
consulting.subtitle: Support in religious, social and legal matters.
body: Not every question has an easy answer. Our advisors are here to help with questions about Islam, everyday family matters, and finding your way through social and legal processes in Germany.
Consultations are confidential and open to anyone in the community, regardless of background.

donation.title: Mosque’s fundraising campaign
donation.subtitle: An active contribution to our mosque and community.
body: Our mosque and its programmes are entirely funded by the community. Every donation, large or small, goes directly toward prayer facilities, Quran lessons, events and social support.
You can support us with a one-time gift or a regular contribution – every contribution helps secure An-Nur's future.
